description: Composition bakeoff: original 3-phrase train and 2-phrase selection pools unchanged; independent 2-phrase final holdout, authored before evaluation; 8 axes with affirm/deny; silence=no clause. Diagnostic only.

positive: The designated officer is empowered to authorize this step
Approval power has been granted to the responsible agent
The accountable representative may validly sanction this action
negative: The designated officer lacks authority to authorize this step
Approval power has not been granted to the responsible agent
The accountable representative may not validly sanction this action

positive: The contracting participant is required to perform the stated task
A mandatory promise binds the party to complete the work
Failure to undertake this action would breach a binding duty
negative: The contracting participant is not required to perform the stated task
No mandatory promise binds the party to complete the work
Failure to undertake this action would not breach a binding duty

positive: The operation consumes a specifically allocated pool of capacity
A scarce unit of supply is assigned to this transaction
The requested computation draws on a reserved resource budget
negative: The operation consumes no specifically allocated pool of capacity
No scarce unit of supply is assigned to this transaction
The requested computation draws on no reserved resource budget

positive: Verified records substantiate the statement under review
The presented logs corroborate the proposition
A documented audit trail supports the asserted fact
negative: Verified records do not substantiate the statement under review
The presented logs fail to corroborate the proposition
No documented audit trail supports the asserted fact

positive: The action is constrained by a binding completion date
Execution is permitted only within a specified interval
The operation must respect a prescribed sequence in time
negative: The action is not constrained by a binding completion date
Execution is not limited to a specified interval
The operation need not respect any prescribed sequence in time

positive: The outcome cannot yet be determined from available facts
Multiple possibilities remain unresolved for this decision
The current interpretation is genuinely indeterminate
negative: The outcome can now be determined from available facts
No possibilities remain unresolved for this decision
The current interpretation is fully determinate

positive: The governing constraint forbids the proposed combination
These alternatives are mutually prohibited from co-occurring
A binding rule excludes the requested operation
negative: The governing constraint does not forbid the proposed combination
These alternatives are permitted to co-occur
No binding rule excludes the requested operation

positive: Completing the step produces a specified downstream effect
The action changes the resulting operational state
This event triggers a defined contractual outcome
negative: Completing the step produces no specified downstream effect
The action does not change the resulting operational state
This event triggers no defined contractual outcome

positive: The named delegate holds valid decision-making power
A duly empowered actor can give binding approval
negative: The named delegate holds no valid decision-making power
No duly empowered actor can give binding approval

positive: Performance is compulsory for the party concerned
The actor remains bound to discharge this commitment
negative: Performance is optional for the party concerned
The actor is not bound to discharge this commitment

positive: A finite allotment is consumed by the requested work
The arrangement earmarks a scarce asset for use
negative: No finite allotment is consumed by the requested work
The arrangement does not earmark a scarce asset for use

positive: Corroborating documentation backs the disputed assertion
Recorded proof supports the stated claim
negative: Corroborating documentation fails to back the disputed assertion
Recorded proof does not support the stated claim

positive: A definite cutoff governs when the step can happen
The permission has an enforceable period of validity
negative: No definite cutoff governs when the step can happen
The permission has no enforceable period of validity

positive: The available observations leave the answer unsettled
It remains unclear which potential result will occur
negative: The available observations settle the answer completely
It is clear which result will occur

positive: The rule expressly rules out combining these activities
The requested pairing violates a prohibition
negative: The rule expressly permits combining these activities
The requested pairing violates no prohibition

positive: The step has a prescribed effect on what follows
A specified state transition results from this action
negative: The step has no prescribed effect on what follows
No specified state transition results from this action

positive: The appointed coordinator possesses lawful approval power over this operation
The named decision maker is authorized to permit this action
negative: The appointed coordinator has no lawful power to approve this operation
Permitting this action lies beyond the named decision maker's authority

positive: The participant must carry out the assigned deliverable under the agreement
The arrangement binds the responsible party to fulfill this requirement
negative: The participant may decline the assigned deliverable without violating the agreement
No enforceable requirement binds the responsible party to complete this task

positive: A limited reserve is committed to the requested operation
Processing the request draws from a finite supply of capacity
negative: No limited reserve is committed to the requested operation
Processing the request does not draw from any finite supply of capacity

positive: Independent records corroborate this factual assertion
Traceable documentation establishes support for the disputed claim
negative: Independent records fail to corroborate this factual assertion
No traceable documentation supports the disputed claim

positive: The permission ceases to apply after a specified deadline
An enforceable scheduling window restricts the action
negative: The permission remains valid without any deadline
The action is not restricted by an enforceable scheduling window

positive: The evidence leaves multiple possible outcomes unresolved
Available observations cannot yet settle the choice
negative: The evidence resolves the outcome without remaining alternatives
Available observations fully settle the choice

positive: A binding restriction prevents the two actions from occurring together
The governing rules disallow the proposed pairing
negative: No binding restriction prevents the two actions from occurring together
The governing rules allow the proposed pairing

positive: This step activates a specified downstream obligation
Completing the operation changes the contractually defined result
negative: This step activates no specified downstream obligation
Completing the operation leaves the contractually defined result unchanged
